result.instructions: Tools for Spotler CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which opportunities are open for more than 90 days, and who owns them?"; "List the contacts added this month whose company is Acme."; "What are the required fields to create a case?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spotler CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spotler_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spotler_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spotler_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. spotler_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spotler_list_records
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List records of one type (contacts, accounts, opportunities, cases, and so on), with optional JSON filter and order, and page through them (limit up to 100, page). Returns only the records your access token can see. Some types need a Professional or Enterprise plan; campaign types need the Marketing tool, and cases need the Service & Support tool. Spotler CRM API: GET /{object}.

object.description: The record type (object name), for example contacts or opportunities.

q.description: Filter as a JSON object, for example {"name": "Test"} or {"name": {"$con": "tes"}}. Field names must match the data dictionary.

order.description: Sort order as a JSON object, for example {"name": "asc"}.

lines.description: Opportunities only: return the line items inline under the key 'lines'.

tools.name: spotler_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Get one record by type and id. For opportunities, lines=true adds the line items. Spotler CRM API: GET /{object}/{id}.

object.description: The record type (object name), for example contacts or opportunities.

id.description: The record id, for example from spotler_list_records.

lines.description: Opportunities only: return the line items inline under the key 'lines'.

tools.name: spotler_get_data_dictionary
tools.title: Get the data dictionary
tools.description: List every field of one record type, with its type and whether it is required when you create the record. Use it before spotler_create_record or spotler_update_record. Spotler CRM API: GET /datadictionary/{object}.

object.description: The record type (object name), for example contacts or opportunities.

tools.name: spotler_get_lookup_values
tools.title: Get dropdown values
tools.description: Get the values of one dropdown or lookup list field of a record type, for example the account types (object accounts, field type). Spotler CRM API: GET /lookup/{object}/{field}.

object.description: The record type (object name), for example contacts or opportunities.

field.description: The field name of the dropdown, for example type.

tools.name: spotler_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: Create one record of a type in the CRM. Writes live CRM data: all required fields must be in data (see spotler_get_data_dictionary). Spotler CRM API: POST /{object}.

object.description: The record type (object name), for example contacts or opportunities.

data.description: The field values as a JSON object. Call spotler_get_data_dictionary first to see the field names and required fields.

tools.name: spotler_update_record
tools.title: Update a record
tools.description: Update fields of one existing record. Only the fields in data change. Writes live CRM data. Spotler CRM API: PATCH /{object}/{id}.

object.description: The record type (object name), for example contacts or opportunities.

id.description: The record id, for example from spotler_list_records.

data.description: The field values as a JSON object. Call spotler_get_data_dictionary first to see the field names and required fields.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Spotler CRM
prompts.description: What you can do with Spotler CRM here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_open_opportunities_and_their_owners
prompts.title: Find open opportunities and their owners
prompts.description: List opportunities with a JSON filter and order. Open one opportunity with its line items, then ask which deals have been open for more than 90 days.

prompts.name: look_up_contacts_and_accounts
prompts.title: Look up contacts and accounts
prompts.description: List contacts or accounts with a filter and paging. Open one record by its type and id to read its fields.

prompts.name: check_required_fields_and_dropdown_values
prompts.title: Check required fields and dropdown values
prompts.description: Read the fields of a record type and see which ones are required. List the dropdown values, such as account types, before you enter data.

prompts.name: create_or_update_a_crm_record
prompts.title: Create or update a CRM record
prompts.description: Read the data dictionary first. Then create a record or update the fields of one existing record. The write changes live CRM data.
